raw_text: The Indian Navy has been conducting a sustained anti-submarine warfare operation in the Bay of Bengal, tracking a Chinese nuclear-powered attack submarine for approximately 72 hours, defence sources confirmed to India Today. The submarine, assessed as a Type 093A Shang-class SSN, was detected east of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. P-8I Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft and the anti-submarine corvette INS Kadmatt were deployed for the tracking operation. This marks a significant PLAN subsurface deployment in waters India considers strategically vital.
